title: Wellington Knox and the other clarinet students
summary: His uncle Wellington Knox played in the band; they discuss whether he is related to Emile Knox of the Young Tuxedo band, and boys who gave up lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings
